verdict.rationale: Gazebo's own docs show it can generate simulated sensor data, with optional noise, from cameras, lidars, IMU and other sensors. It can also run headless as a server-only package suited to CI, which roughly covers the synthetic-data half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows reinforcement learning support or parallel execution at scale. Missing for 10: RL training interfaces or environments, parallel or batched simulation at scale, training-data features such as ground-truth labels or segmentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can generate synthetic training data and run reinforcement learning at scale in simulation

citations.quote: Generate sensor data, optionally with noise, from laser range finders, 2D/3D cameras, Kinect style sensors, contact sensors, force-torque, IMU, GPS, and more
Gazebo Sim can also be run headless, i.e. without the GUI, by using the -s (server only) flag.
For headless and CI environments where the GUI is not needed, the `gz-sim10-server` package provides a lightweight alternative.
Run simulation on remote servers and interface to Gazebo Sim through socket-based message passing using Gazebo Transport.
